newsitem.title: INDIA: India Asian Electronics shr jumps 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: India Asian Electronics shr jumps 8 pct.

text.p: Shares of Asian Electronics rose sharply for the second straight day at Bombay exchanges after the firm said it was raising foreign portfolio holding limits to 30 percent from 24 percent, brokers said on Tuesday.
The share was up 10 rupees, or 7.84 percent, at 137.50 on the Bombay Stock Exchange at 0645 GMT on Tuesday, after rising 10 percent on Monday.
The company said on Monday its board decided on Monday to issue shares worth $6 million to the International Finance Corporation and set a minimum offer price of 150 rupees a share.
